moworks.notes: Chrome panel 228x120 r14 (vertical gradient bands dark / light / dark / light). Tap at 0.6 s at (144,98): 4 rings 0.14 s apart, radius 0 → 170 px power2.out over 1.8 s, opacity (1 − p) × (1 − 0.18 k); each ring = a dark 3.5 px contour at 55 %, a bright 1.4 px contour 3 px outside (the first ring accent 2.2 px) and a faint 0.8 px inner line. A dark dimple r7 at the tap point 0.55-1.2 s. Clipped to the panel. Params: at · rings (4, cách 0.14 s) · radius (170 px) · duration (1.8 s, power2.out) · fade.
